facts.fact: Julienne 电话里布置：让死亡账算到 Roux 与 Barley 头上。
facts.anchor: “We need to figure this out with the Rouxs and Barleys before they become even more problematic. No one else can tie us to the deaths. We need it to fall back on them,”

facts.fact: 毒必须看起来来自对方阵营，乱局正是他们要的。
facts.anchor: The poison needs to appear to come from their side. We need the unrest, we need the problems.

facts.fact: 老大要把烈性毒品重新推上街头。
facts.anchor: Boss wants to push the hardcore drugs back on the streets.

facts.fact: 通话人 Scotch 报告：Aldente 家的儿子会惹麻烦。
facts.anchor: “The Aldente boy is going to cause problems.”

facts.fact: Julienne 命令 Scotch：搞不定就交给他父亲处理。
facts.anchor: “Scotch. If you can’t, let his father deal with him.”

facts.fact: 产品里加料、过量致死人数在所不惜，他哥哥已在全城铺货。
facts.anchor: I don’t care who dies because of it. My brother is already distributing it across the city.

facts.fact: 一个新来的女人被推进门，Julienne 心生厌烦。
facts.anchor: Annoyance jolts through me as a new woman is shoved through the door.

facts.fact: 前一个厨师失踪了——他放话找回时要让她后悔。
facts.anchor: Right, the other one decided to go missing. I would make sure they regretted that when found.

facts.fact: 她结巴着报菜名：黑炸三文鱼配蘑菇烩饭。
facts.anchor: “It’s a blackened salmon with a m-m-mushroom risotto.

facts.fact: 她逐项报完配料，他才放心咬下第一口。
facts.anchor: She lists them all, and satisfied, I take a bite.

facts.fact: 他抬眼看她那张脸和沾了污渍的白外套，问你是谁。
facts.anchor: My eyes flash up to her face, to the stained white coat she wears. “Who are you?”

facts.fact: 她报出名字：呃，Cinnamon？
facts.anchor: “Uh, Cinnamon?”

facts.fact: 这个名字让他一惊，随即喝令她出去。
facts.anchor: I jolt at the name. “Leave.”

facts.fact: 她留下一句：还有剩菜，怕不够的话。
facts.anchor: “There will be leftovers. Just in case that’s not enough.”

facts.fact: 他没多想就把整盘吃得精光。
facts.anchor: Before I know what I am doing, I devour the rest of the plate.

facts.fact: 冷汗中惊醒，他恍惚走向厨房热了另一份烩饭。
facts.anchor: Stumbling out of bed, I make my way to the kitchen. In a haze, I heat up another plate of the risotto.

facts.fact: 喉咙肿起来，他意识到自己犯了错。
facts.anchor: My throat swells, and I realize my mistake.

facts.fact: 这份剩菜里多了一样他致命过敏的东西。
facts.anchor: This had an additional ingredient. Something I was deadly allergic to.

facts.fact: 一个无人知晓的过敏。
facts.anchor: The allergy no one knew I had.

facts.fact: 他一生避之不及的那味料——吃了会要命。
facts.anchor: The one ingredient I avoided at all costs… because eating it could take my life.

facts.fact: 那味料是：肉桂。
facts.anchor: Cinnamon.
